fidelity: F2a — Recuperated Brayton Cycle (Physics-Lumped) with Shaft + Recuperator Thermal ODE
source: Moran, Shapiro, Boettner & Bailey (2018) Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics 9e, Wiley (Ch. 9 gas turbine / Brayton + recuperation); Capstone C200 product data sheet (2023); US EPA CHP Catalog (2017) Section 5: Microturbines; ISO 2314:2009; Cengel & Boles (2015) Thermodynamics 8e (air-standard cp(T)).

unit.name: Generic 200 kWe Recuperated Micro Gas Turbine (Capstone C200-class)

P_el_rated_kw.note: ISO-rated net electrical output at 15 degC, 101.325 kPa, sea level (Capstone C200)

eta_el_rated.note: Net electrical efficiency at full load (LHV, ISO). Used only for reference/normalisation; F2 computes efficiency from the cycle.

pressure_ratio.note: Compressor total pressure ratio. Micro gas turbines run low PR (~3-4) because recuperation, not high PR, drives efficiency (Capstone, EPA CHP Catalog).

T_amb_k.note: ISO reference compressor inlet (ambient) temperature, 15 degC

TIT_k.note: Turbine inlet temperature (950 degC), typical recuperated micro turbine, limited by uncooled radial turbine + recuperator material

eta_comp_isen.note: Compressor isentropic efficiency (small single-stage centrifugal compressor)

eta_turb_isen.note: Turbine isentropic efficiency (single-stage radial inflow turbine)

dp_comb_frac.note: Fractional combustor + hot-side ducting pressure loss

dp_recup_cold_frac.note: Recuperator cold-side (compressed air) fractional pressure loss

recup_effectiveness.note: Recuperator effectiveness (epsilon). The single most important efficiency driver for micro gas turbines; without it eta would be ~17%.

eta_gen.note: High-speed generator + power-electronics (rectifier/inverter) combined electrical efficiency

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas (CH4-rich)

rho_gas_kgm3.note: Density of natural gas at STP

mdot_air_rated_kgs.note: Rated compressor air mass flow at ISO full load (Capstone C200-class, ~1.3-1.7 kg/s; calibrated so net shaft*generator output = 200 kWe nameplate)

shaft_inertia_J.note: Polar moment of inertia of the single high-speed spool (compressor+turbine+rotor)

shaft_speed_rated_rpm.note: Rated spool speed (high-speed single shaft, ~45-96 krpm class)

recup_mass_kg.note: Recuperator metal thermal mass (dominant lumped thermal capacitance, sets warm-up time constant)

cp_air_jkgK.note: Air cp near ambient (Cengel & Boles 2015). Temperature-dependent cp(T) used internally; this is the cold-end reference.

cp_gas_jkgK.note: Combustion-gas cp near turbine temperatures (Cengel & Boles 2015). Temperature-dependent cp(T) used internally; this is the hot-end reference.

gamma_air.note: Air ratio of specific heats near ambient (Moran 2018)

gamma_gas.note: Combustion-gas ratio of specific heats at high T (Moran 2018)
